Chapter03Proof

Five engagements, told the way we work: the problem, the thinking, the outcome.

CASE 01 · HEALTHCARE

Everyone Clinic

Virtual family & geriatric care · Platform, ongoing operation
Problem

Patients, many of them older or vulnerable, had to trust a clinic they would never walk into.

Thinking

Trust is a design outcome: a calm clinical presence, secure appointment flows, and accessibility engineered for the people who need it most.

Outcome

A platform patients use without help, operated continuously by the studio that built it.

CASE 02 · FINANCE

FundCrown

US investment firm · Brand, web, ongoing operation
Problem

A firm managing serious capital needed a digital presence where a single careless sentence is a liability, not a typo.

Thinking

Discipline as a design principle: premium institutional presence, compliance-aware copy, every claim weighed before it was written.

Outcome

Built, then operated month after month as managed infrastructure, not handed over and forgotten.

CASE 03 · CONSUMER BRAND

Mansura

Home linens brand · Brand build & growth roadmap
Problem

Real products, real customers, and no unified face: every channel spoke with a different voice.

Thinking

One brand first, then everything else: complete visual identity, a content strategy built on it, and a roadmap so next year is a plan, not a guess.

Outcome

One recognizable brand across every touchpoint, from packaging to feed.

CASE 04 · MEDIA

TRT Digital

Public broadcaster · Digital platforms, founding team role
Problem

Global newsrooms had to publish at scale from day one: templates, infrastructure, and websites able to carry the load, none of it existing yet.

Thinking

Build the system before the stories. As part of the founding team: the editorial templates, the infrastructure, and the platforms from the ground up. Later, a regional news platform launched with its identity, policies, and 300+ explainer stories.

Outcome

Foundations designed to outlive launch week, and they did.

CASE 05 · STREAMING

tabii

Global streaming platform · Founding team role
Problem

A public broadcaster decided to enter global streaming against entrenched giants: no name, no identity rules, no operating playbook, and a hard launch date.

Thinking

Start where platforms live or die: the name, the governance, the rulebook. Thrive's founder worked on the founding alongside four others, from the name itself to the regulations the platform runs on.

Outcome

Launched in 2023 on its own technical infrastructure. Several million subscribers in the first year, with 30+ originals.

Chapter04The difference

Clients keep telling us the same thing: they can buy design anywhere. They stay for the thinking.

Evidence before design

We read your market, your published materials, and your competitors before we open a design tool. Nothing is claimed about your business that we have not verified from your own sources.

Systems over one-offs

A launch is a week. An operation is years. We build templates, calendars, and governance so quality survives the excitement of week one, month after month.

The audience decides

We design for the person meant to act. Beauty serves the message, the message serves the return, and both start from knowing exactly who is reading.

Chapter05The numbers

Published US industry guides for 2026 put a professional corporate website between $5,000 and $60,000, a full identity program between $3,000 and $25,000 (up to $75,000 with strategy), and agency retainers between $2,500 and $10,000 a month. That is the market being honest about what serious work costs.

We build from the DC metro, where agencies add a 20 to 40 percent regional premium. We charge national baseline rates instead: engineered systems remove the waste that premium pays for. What we never compress: quality and sustainability.

The saving comes from engineering, not from juniors. Lead architects in the US bill $150 to $300 an hour; our systems keep that level of judgment on your account without the meter running.
